operating_boundary: Local research only, no external distribution; retain publisher attribution, CC BY-SA license link, modification notice and share-alike provenance. This is a self-imposed task boundary, not a claim CC BY-SA is research-only or that conflict was legally resolved.
label_source_priority: AAU is the original annotation table; COCO is an exactly matching box representation. Use original split/frame filename universe only within publisher-declared coverage to restore image identity for zero-annotation frames. Never merge YOLO to invent missing labels.
empty_frame_status: Publisher-declared covered, no target annotation; not proven true object absence. Exclude every frame outside stated first-200/first-100 limits regardless of empty or positive annotation.

frame_numbering_evidence.note: image2 output muxer default 1; not the input demuxer default 0. OpenCV sequential decoder first index 0 maps to released -0001 filename.

reason: No ffmpeg command-line executable installed. Existing OpenCV/FFmpeg libraries decode locally; OpenCV cubic resizing is explicitly a QA rendering, not assumed pixel-identical to official swscale bicubic.
